label: Move existing password hashes into Better Auth accounts

precheck.description: Legacy password hashes still need credential accounts
precheck.sql: SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "public"."user" AS legacy WHERE legacy."password" IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "public"."account" AS credential WHERE credential."userId" = legacy."id" AND credential."providerId" = 'credential' AND credential."accountId" = legacy."id" AND credential."password" IS NOT NULL))

execute.description: Copy existing bcrypt hashes into credential accounts
execute.sql: INSERT INTO "public"."account" ("id", "accountId", "providerId", "userId", "password", "createdAt", "updatedAt") SELECT gen_random_uuid()::text, legacy."id", 'credential', legacy."id", legacy."password", now(), now() FROM "public"."user" AS legacy WHERE legacy."password" IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "public"."account" AS credential WHERE credential."userId" = legacy."id" AND credential."providerId" = 'credential' AND credential."accountId" = legacy."id" AND credential."password" IS NOT NULL)

execute.description: Clear old password hashes after the credential copy
execute.sql: UPDATE "public"."user" AS legacy SET "password" = NULL WHERE legacy."password" IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "public"."account" AS credential WHERE credential."userId" = legacy."id" AND credential."providerId" = 'credential' AND credential."accountId" = legacy."id" AND credential."password" = legacy."password")

postcheck.description: Every prior password hash has a credential account and is cleared from user
postcheck.sql: SELECT NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "public"."user" AS legacy WHERE legacy."password" IS NOT NULL)
